name: Dark Seduction - Inspired by Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium | Intense Perfume for Women
description: Dark Seduction, inspired by the sultry Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium, is a captivating fragrance for women who exude confidence and mystery. The scent opens with a thrilling blend of black coffee and pear. This creates an invigorating allure right from the start. At its heart, jasmine and orange blossom unfold elegantly. Meanwhile, the base notes of vanilla, cedarwood, and patchouli leave an unforgettable impression. With a 40-50% perfume oil concentration, Dark Seduction delivers exceptional longevity and sillage. It is the perfect companion for evenings, romantic encounters, and special occasions. This fragrance envelops you in an aura of irresistible charm and keeps you feeling confident. Features Top Notes: Black Coffee, Pear Heart Notes: Jasmine, Orange Blossom Base Notes: Vanilla, Cedarwood, Patchouli Longevity: 8-10 hours (Very Long-Lasting) Occasion: Perfect for evening wear, romantic nights, and formal events Why Choose Dark Seduction? Inspired by the iconic Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Crafted with premium ingredients and a rich concentration A bold, intoxicating fragrance that leaves a lasting impression Exclusively available at Scents by Aamir, blending luxury with affordability Materials & Care Content: Alcohol-based perfume infused with premium-quality oils Care: Keep away from direct sunlight and store in a cool, dry place Packaging: Delivered in a sleek and elegant glass bottle for effortless use
